name: en_to_de_noun
description: Translate short English sentence into German; answer is German noun after the article. Control: reverse direction (German->English), English noun.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
nouns=[("house","Haus","dem"),("table","Tisch","dem"),("car","Auto","dem"),("door","Tür","der"),("window","Fenster","dem"),("book","Buch","dem"),("garden","Garten","dem"),("kitchen","Küche","der"),("city","Stadt","der"),("street","Straße","der"),("school","Schule","der"),("church","Kirche","der"),("forest","Wald","dem"),("river","Fluss","dem"),("bed","Bett","dem"),("box","Kiste","der"),("bag","Tasche","der"),("tree","Baum","dem"),("room","Zimmer","dem"),("market","Markt","dem"),("train","Zug","dem"),("boat","Boot","dem"),("park","Park","dem"),("office","Büro","dem"),("village","Dorf","dem"),("bottle","Flasche","der"),("shop","Laden","dem"),("field","Feld","dem"),("castle","Schloss","dem"),("library","Bibliothek","der")]
subj=[("The dog","Der Hund"),("The cat","Die Katze"),("My brother","Mein Bruder"),("The child","Das Kind"),("The teacher","Der Lehrer"),("My mother","Meine Mutter")]
preps=[("is in","ist in"),("is near","ist neben"),("is behind","ist hinter"),("is under","ist unter"),("sleeps in","schläft in"),("waits behind","wartet hinter")]
items=[];ctrl=[];seen=set()
while len(items)<120:
    n=random.choice(nouns);s=random.choice(subj);p=random.choice(preps)
    key=(n[0],s[0],p[0])
    if key in seen: continue
    seen.add(key)
    en=f"{s[0]} {p[0]} the {n[0]}."
    items.append({"prompt":f"English: {en}\nGerman: {s[1]} {p[1]} {n[2]}","answer":" "+n[1]})
    ctrl.append({"prompt":f"German: {s[1]} {p[1]} {n[2]} {n[1]}.\nEnglish: {s[0]} {p[0]} the","answer":" "+n[0]})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":ctrl},open('/work/skill.json','w'),ensure_ascii=False)
